job.title: Lead Full Stack Developer - SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies | Senior Java & Hybris Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, production support, code reviews and leading junior developers. Strong techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and stakeholder management in international agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead Full Stack Developer - SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Pfeiffer Vacuum’s commitment to innovative vacuum solutions and its global digital transformation. With more than five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to drive your e-commerce platform forward.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data, following platform best practices and design patterns.

bullets.label: Full Stack Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and integrated them with JavaScript-based PWA frontends, while also customizing backoffice components and UI extensions.

bullets.label: Integration Leadership
bullets.text: I led PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM, coordinating international technical teams.

bullets.label: Team & Quality
bullets.text: I performed code reviews, mentored junior developers, and drove CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), ensuring high code quality and stable production operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Lead Full Stack Developer - SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
cover_de.hook: Die Innovationskraft von Pfeiffer Vacuum im Bereich Vakuum- und Überdrucklösungen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell möchte ich Ihre digitale E-Commerce-Strategie aktiv mitgestalten.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, inkl. Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendaten, stets nach Plattform-Best-Practices und Design-Patterns.

bullets.label: Full-Stack-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Web-Services für Headless-Storefronts bereitgestellt und diese mit JavaScript-basierten PWA-Frontends integriert sowie Backoffice-Komponenten und UI-Erweiterungen angepasst.

bullets.label: Integrations-Leadership
bullets.text: Ich leitete PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub und löste Integrationsengpässe zu SAP ERP und MDM, dabei internationale technische Teams koordiniert.

bullets.label: Team- & Qualitäts-Management
bullets.text: Ich führte Code-Reviews durch, betreute Junior-Entwickler und steuerte CI/CD-Deployments auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), um hohe Code-Qualität und stabile Produktion sicherzustellen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist (frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026). Gerne erläutere ich in einem Gespräch, wie ich Ihr Team bereichern kann.

tailoring.why_company: Pfeiffer Vacuum’s reputation for innovative vacuum and over-pressure solutions across diverse industries aligns with my passion for building robust, high-performance e-commerce platforms that support complex product portfolios. The company’s global footprint, commitment to sustainability and forward-looking digital transformation provide an ideal environment where I can apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to deliver seamless customer experiences and help shape the next generation of vacuum technologies.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and full-stack expertise to help Pfeiffer Vacuum deliver cutting-edge digital experiences for its global customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Lead Full Stack role at Pfeiffer Vacuum and would love to discuss how I can contribute. – see my CV attached.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Lead Full Stack Developer position at Pfeiffer Vacuum. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to your e-commerce and digital initiatives. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
